targets_note: Rows 1-4 measure WarmBranchPool::acquire on a warm hit: one renameatx_np(RENAME_EXCL) of a standby cloned earlier, p50 0.1002-0.1465 ms across 4 fixtures (960 hits, 0 misses; a row passes only without misses). The gated acquire and rollback rows are timed with the pool idle (settle before each acquire, rollback after the refill finished); the contended cases are reported next to them. The pool does not make clonefile cheaper: a cold clonefile is still O(entries) inside the kernel, p50 0.172 ms at 9 files and 7.729 ms at 1025 files, with getrusage ru_stime of 7.91-13.42 us per tree entry, and every acquire is paid for by one refill clone off the caller's path (standby replenish p50 1.117 ms small, 7.943 ms medium). An acquire right after a commit finds the standby stale: at medium 1/60 fell back to a cold clone and 59/60 waited for the refill in flight, p50 10.820 ms. A commit or rollback issued while the refill clone runs waits behind it (small: commit 1.643 ms, rollback 1.289 ms p50). The commit row times the RENAME_SWAP syscall (small p50 0.130 ms); the caller-visible commit (lock, checks, swap, version) has p50 0.465 ms. The online-model rows time back-to-back calls (cpuAndNeuralEngine p50 0.175 ms, cpuOnly 0.220 ms). One call after a 3.0 ms gap takes 0.368 ms with the CPU busy in the gap and 0.851 ms with it idle (cpuOnly 0.212 / 1.461 ms: cpuAndNeuralEngine is slower than cpuOnly with a busy CPU, speedup 0.58, and faster with an idle CPU, speedup 1.72). The end-to-end ane_score stage, one call per transaction, has p50 0.374 ms, 2.14x the back-to-back p50 and 1.02x the busy-gap isolated p50. Live-tree integrity: 30/30 checks passed, stores clean: true. One run on Apple M2, 11/11 gated rows passed. This run is PRELIMINARY (1-min load average 13.13 at end above the busy threshold 4); only a quiet full-scale run decides the phase result.
